steps.en: A summary report is generated every day automatically
steps.id: Laporan ringkasan dibuat otomatis setiap hari

steps.en: The report lists notices suspended temporarily for a mismatch
steps.id: Laporan memuat notice yang di-suspend sementara karena selisih

steps.en: The report lists notices that were updated as paid
steps.id: Laporan memuat notice yang sudah di-update sebagai lunas
steps.why_en: Partial payments and refunds are listed; notices the officer later settled in full are not.
steps.why_id: Bayar sebagian dan refund tercantum; notice yang kemudian dilunasi officer tidak tercantum.

steps.en: The report has the details needed for follow-up
steps.id: Laporan punya detail yang dibutuhkan untuk follow-up
steps.why_en: Payment and receipt details are there; the amount payable and the reason for the mismatch are not.
steps.why_id: Detail pembayaran dan receipt ada; jumlah yang harus dibayar dan alasan selisih tidak ada.

steps.en: The officer can view and download the report
steps.id: Officer bisa melihat dan mengunduh laporan
